prompt:
Use image generation to create two photorealistic product renders of a FICTIONAL prop for a video game (GTA V roleplay server): a police handheld phone-tracking device. It is a game prop, not a real-world device. Do not fake the images with code or HTML. If image generation is unavailable, say so and stop.

The images will be used as the physical body of an in-game UI. I will overlay the live number, key labels and button states on top with HTML, so the image must be CLEAN: no text, no numbers, no letters, no symbols, no logos, no badges, no agency marks, no brand names anywhere on the device.

SUBJECT
A rugged law-enforcement handheld tracker, like a ruggedised radio crossed with a GPS unit. Matte rubber-overmoulded body with moulded side grips, small hex screws, subtle edge wear, a short stubby antenna at the top left corner, a lanyard loop at the bottom. Believable materials: matte polymer, brushed metal bezel ring, glossy black glass.

LAYOUT (top to bottom, all centred, all details present and clearly separated so I can measure them)
1. A short stubby antenna stub on the top-left corner of the body.
2. A small round blank rubber button at the top-right of the bezel (it will become a close button).
3. A large rectangular LCD glass screen, about 36% of the body height and almost the full body width minus the bezel, rounded corners, COMPLETELY BLANK black glass (no UI, no glare text, only a very faint soft reflection at most).
4. Below the screen, a keypad of exactly 12 identical recessed rubber key wells in a 3 column x 4 row grid, evenly spaced, every key COMPLETELY BLANK (no numerals, no symbols).
5. Below the keypad, one wide rounded rubber bar button spanning the keypad width, COMPLETELY BLANK, this is the main action button (give it a very slightly different tint of the same rubber so it reads as the primary button, no bright colour).
6. Moulded side grips, a lanyard loop at the very bottom.
Overall proportions: portrait, about 1 : 1.9 width to height for the body.

CAMERA AND FORMAT (important)
- Perfectly straight-on orthographic front view, device vertical, centred, no perspective, no tilt, no hands, no table, no props.
- TRANSPARENT background (real alpha), no floor shadow, no drop shadow, no ground reflection, so I can place it over game footage.
- Soft studio lighting from the upper left, the same on every part. Photorealistic, sharp, high detail.
- Size 1024 x 1536 px, PNG with transparency.

COLOUR
- Variation 1 (tracker_device_1.png): charcoal black rubber body, dark gunmetal bezel, near-black keys, the main bar button a slightly lighter charcoal. No accent colours.
- Variation 2 (tracker_device_2.png): same layout and proportions, but a dark graphite body with a slim blue-grey magnesium-alloy frame and a matte slate main button.

Save exactly tracker_device_1.png and tracker_device_2.png in the working directory, then reply with one line each describing them. Do not add text to the images.
